subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar replace the current share-card story with this activity-first, bounded per-source model-route artifact described by the open design tracker?
rationale: The final patch and proof appear to resolve the concrete implementation concerns, but choosing the public sharing narrative and its information hierarchy requires owner intent rather than a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Sponsor the redesigned artifact
options.body: Accept the activity-first card as the bounded social-share contract and proceed with normal final merge review.

options.title: Pause for a narrower direction
options.body: Keep the current artifact until the design tracker specifies a different hierarchy, scope, or presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the redesigned artifact
recommendation.body: Accept the activity-first card as the bounded social-share contract and proceed with normal final merge review.
